kapela_bio: A Bratislava-based group formed around Kasko, Bebe, Vlado Janček and Jožo Lipa, active since 2011. They describe their style as "primitive rock" and "post-chanson". Their discography includes the albums Bozkávam, Tretí album and LOM.
A Námestovo-based beer-fuelled punk-rock staple. Their motto says it all: "Punk and Beer since 2010."
A hard rock band from Trstená, delivering honest guitar riffs straight from the Orava region.

A Martin-based punk-rock band with a long history of lineup changes. Despite going through numerous different lineups over the years, they have remained faithful to their melodic punk-rock sound and humorous style.
A punk lineup from Žilina, brought together for one proper punk night at Furmanka.
A Dolný Kubín punk legend, still respected by younger bands from the Bratislava Oi! scene.

A folk singer-songwriter from Štefanov nad Oravou, bringing traditional Orava folk songs to life with his guitar and distinctive folk performance. His music is inspired by life in the Orava region, with a love of nature and traditional folk music at its heart. He regularly performs at folk festivals and cultural events throughout Slovakia.
A pornofolk legend from Znojmo. Not suitable for children or sensitive audiences – their own words.

A Bratislava-based Oi!/hardcore punk band founded in May 1999, still committed to the DIY philosophy under their own label, Žiadna značka – No Label. Their releases include the albums Ilegálna spravodlivosť and Hrubá Sila. They have maintained a clear anti-fascist stance throughout their long career.
A garage punk band from Košice, describing themselves as a bunch of "ugly perverse boys". Their debut album Rande s vrahom shook up the Czech and Slovak punk scene with its raw, dirty garage sound.
A Námestovo-based beer-fuelled punk-rock staple. Their motto says it all: "Punk and Beer since 2010."
A rock staple of the Dolný Kubín and Orava music scene, keeping traditional dance parties going until the early hours for years.
A band from Dolný Kubín delivering rock hits backed by powerful bass lines.

A Žilina-based DIY singer-songwriter and one-person punk institution, active since the mid-2000s. He plays acoustic lo-fi folk-punk and has toured across Europe, including London. His discography includes numerous splits and albums released independently.
Acoustic punk from Banská Bystrica, raw and straightforward, just as the name suggests.
A singer-songwriter from Žilina, blending acoustic punk with poetry.
A punk-rock band from Handlová, fast and explosive, just like their name.

A cult punk-rock band from Čadca, founded on 10 October 1988 and still going strong – one of the oldest punk bands in Slovakia. Their Kysuce punk sound is raw, direct and stripped of unnecessary frills, as confirmed by their recent album Koniec jednej epizódy.
A Námestovo-based beer-fuelled punk-rock staple. Their motto says it all: "Punk and Beer since 2010."
Agro heavy punk by the square metre, straight from Hruštín. Regular guests at major punk gatherings, including Slovenská krčma at Pohoda Festival.

"A duo of two guitarists whose acoustic performances create a friendly and relaxed atmosphere. Their repertoire includes cover versions of well-known hits as well as original songs. Their performances are characterised by simplicity
plagat: clear sound and the harmony of two guitars."

kapela_bio: A punk'n'roll trio from the Liptov region led by singer TOME (Tomáš Mikulka, finalist of Československo hľadá SuperStar 2020). Inspired by the Rolling Stones and AC/DC, they deliver energetic rock with Slovak lyrics.
A punk question from Stará Bystrica, with one obvious answer: a proper mosh pit.
Originally a solo project by guitarist Oto, now an indie-rock'n'roll band from Topoľčany. They describe themselves on Facebook as "Pure rock'n'roll from a small town with no possible future!"
A punk band from Hlohovec playing what they describe as "hard-hitting punk with a rock edge". They call their style "nonconformist punk". They have been active for over 20 years.
A punk-rock'n'roll band from Stránske near Žilina, active since 1997/98. Over the years, they shared rehearsal spaces and members with the underground Žilina scene surrounding Dáša Fon Fľaša.
Straight-to-the-point punk rock from Bytča, known for its energetic and fast-paced sound.
A folk-rock band from Nižná with roots in the Orava region and catchy melodies.
A ska machine from Bratislava – horns and rhythms that make it impossible to stand still.
Reggae vibes from Spišská Nová Ves, guaranteed to get every dance floor moving.
Kuca-Paca in an acoustic setting – the same beer-fuelled punk crew from Námestovo, just without the electricity.

A punk'n'roll trio from the Liptov region led by singer TOME (Tomáš Mikulka, finalist of Československo hľadá SuperStar 2020). Inspired by the Rolling Stones and AC/DC, they deliver energetic rock with Slovak lyrics.
An alternative band from Bratislava with a distinctive sound and an intense atmosphere.

One of the oldest continuously active punk bands in Slovakia, founded in Banská Bystrica in 1990. Together with Zóna A, they were among the leading names of the Slovak punk scene. Their first demo, Pogoroll, was released in 1991 and immediately won a nationwide rock band competition.
A punk-rock'n'roll trio from Bratislava, often compared by critics to Zóna A. Their debut album Z inej planéty was released in 2016, and they played their first concert around 2012.
A Námestovo-based beer-fuelled punk-rock staple. Their motto says it all: "Punk and Beer since 2010."
A punk-rock band from Handlová, fast and explosive, just like their name.
A band from Tvrdošín playing rock covers and delivering a great party atmosphere.

A legendary punk-rock band from Žiar nad Hronom, active since 1992. They took their name from a popular local beer brand. With over three decades of concerts in Slovakia and the Czech Republic, they also organise their own Sitňan Fest.
Punk from Martin – fast, dirty and honest.
A rock'n'roll band from Bratislava, founded in 2018 by brothers Ján and Jakub Hrčkovci (formerly of Kaktus and Ramones Bratislava). Their debut album was released by Czech label PHR Records.
Originally a solo project by guitarist Oto, now an indie-rock'n'roll band from Topoľčany. They describe themselves on Facebook as "Pure rock'n'roll from a small town with no possible future!"
An acoustic solo project by Tomáš Mikulka, singer of Vintage Boyz and finalist of Československo hľadá SuperStar 2020 – just him, his guitar and cover versions.

Bratislava's "anti-sports punk" band founded by Michal Kaščák (yes, the same person behind Pohoda Festival), together with Štefan Kladivík and Marián Kováč. The first punk band with its own waiter, they have spent years uncompromisingly fighting against all forms of sport.
A garage punk band from Košice, describing themselves as a bunch of "ugly perverse boys". Their debut album Rande s vrahom shook up the Czech and Slovak punk scene with its raw, dirty garage sound.
A rockabilly gang from Martin – double bass, pomade and rock'n'roll.
A ska-punk band from Vsetín, active since 1999 and featuring a brass section since 2006. They have released four albums and played hundreds of concerts across the Czech Republic and Slovakia.
A rock'n'roll band from Brezová pod Bradlom, describing themselves on Facebook with the fitting motto: "Rolls Rojce Rock'n Roll."
A rock staple of the Dolný Kubín and Orava music scene, keeping traditional dance parties going until the early hours for years.

A Martin-based punk-rock band with a long history of lineup changes. Despite going through numerous different lineups over the years, they have remained faithful to their melodic punk-rock sound and humorous style.
A punk-ska band from Zakopane – Polish energy without compromise.

A cult punk-rock band from Čadca, founded on 10 October 1988 and still going strong – one of the oldest punk bands in Slovakia. Their Kysuce punk sound is raw, direct and stripped of unnecessary frills, as confirmed by their recent album Koniec jednej epizódy.

A punk-alternative band from Dubnica nad Váhom, active since spring 2008. Their motto is "never pretend to be someone you're not". Their songs deal with the things that make them angry, without pretending to be anything other than themselves.
Rock covers from Námestovo, performed on home turf.
Progressive punk from Nižná, following its own path through the Orava music scene.
Agro heavy punk by the square metre, straight from Hruštín. Regular guests at major punk gatherings, including Slovenská krčma at Pohoda Festival.

An acoustic solo project by guitarist Oto, known from the band Ironic Modern World. His performances feature well-known rock and pop hits in acoustic arrangements, combined with his distinctive guitar playing and unique vocals. His concerts are all about honest music and a close connection with the audience.

A hardcore punk band from Prešov. Their name says it all: "The only thing wrong with them is their name." They deliver straightforward lyrics, catchy choruses and an energetic live performance. Their releases include the album "A čo bude ďalej...".

A punk-rock band from Žilina led by Michal Ciba, also known as Cybo – a long-time bass player and member of the legendary Hoten Toten. Cybo is part of the Žilina music scene, combining punk rock with a distinctive rock sound. Their releases include the album Jednoduchosť and singles Hradby, Dôkazy, Oxymoron and Plytké Hĺbky.
After two years, the Bratislava band Rumaska returns to Furmanka. Founded in 2015, they combine ska, ska-punk and reggae. Their discography includes the 2022 album Skandémia.

The Plan C is a punk-rock band from Liptovský Mikuláš, founded in 2020. Since their first concert in 2021, they have performed across Slovakia and the Czech Republic. In 2026, they released their first three tracks: Agresor, Nevedomosť and Punkové Dievča.

An eight-piece ska/punk band from Kraków, Poland, founded in 2014. Their music is melodic, upbeat and catchy – they describe it as "ass-kicking ska". In 2022, they released their debut album Spirit of Ska, featuring guitar, bass and drums alongside trombone, trumpet and saxophone.

A folk-punk band from Brezno in the Horehronie region, combining folk, punk, country and bluegrass. They call their unique style "Horehronie Western". Their unusual lineup features banjo, violin, guitar, double bass and drums. Their energetic performances have attracted attention both in Slovakia and abroad. They released a new album in 2026.

A rock cover band from Martin specialising in well-known rock hits. Their energetic performances feature a wide repertoire ranging from the 1980s to the present day. Their professionalism and enthusiasm have won them audiences at various events and concerts.

A reggae, ska and Latin band from Spišská Nová Ves, founded in the summer of 1997. They play an energetic mix of ska, reggae and world music and regularly perform at festivals throughout Central Europe. Their repertoire consists of original songs. Their first released track, "Za to všetko môže...", appeared on the compilation Top Ska And Reggae Hity. In 2003, they recorded their first studio album, Kayla.

A ska-punk band from Vsetín, active since 1999. Their sound combines punk with tuba and accordion. In 2002, they released the punk-rock album Každý to vidí jinak, followed a year later by Punk's not business. The band is known for its energetic performances and DIY approach, demonstrated by their latest music video, which they produced entirely on their own.
